hobbies: Restores vintage German motorcycles in a heated garage in Kansas City.
Bakes Christmas stollen every December and gives it to everyone at work.
personal.sports: Lifelong VfB Stuttgart supporter; adopted the Chiefs in 2009 and claims he saw the Mahomes era coming.
personal.laughs: Any vendor slide that says 'up to'. Sabine telling him a diagram is beautiful and wrong.
personal.smiles: A clean one-line diagram. His daughter correcting his materials science.
personal.regrets: Was so certain about a design in 2012 that he never asked the operator what they needed; it worked, and nobody used it as built.
vacations: Hiking the Dolomites with Sabine every September
Christmas markets in Stuttgart with his brother's family
personal.frailties: Says 'that's physically wrong' before he has finished listening. Apologizes later, sometimes by email at 2 a.m.
personal.generosity: Teaches a free Saturday course on power basics for apprentice electricians.
personal.modesty: Will tell you he is usually right, and then tell you the three times he was not.
